Domestic supply therefore remains declared, not confirmed.
note: Name in the batch is an exhibition/event label ("Prevest Bengaluru Expodent 2023"), not a legal entity; the underlying legal entity is PREVEST DENPRO LIMITED, a listed Indian dental-materials manufacturer at 38 Industrial Estate, Digiana (Jammu). Declared HS 300640 matches the customs records exactly (30064000 dental materials), so no HS correction is needed; a secondary HS 90184900 appears for endodontic files. Industry label "Нефтегаз и химия" is wrong in substance — this is dental materials / medical devices, not oil & gas. Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code. Domestic (in-India) supply is only declared via the website's dealer/distributor references; no GST turnover band, tender award or audited revenue split could be verified, so revenue and export volume are left null rather than estimated. Slug note: importkey.com/countries/india/prevest-denpro-limited returned the full record; the variant prevest-denpro-ltd returned an empty shell page.
